identity.symptom: request ignores cancellation before response headers

what: A jobs request waiting for HTTP headers ignores caller cancellation and keeps the CLI alive after SIGINT.
expected: Caller abort and CLI SIGINT promptly interrupt fetch while response headers are pending.
observed: The fetch signal was not aborted; the public jobs adapter and CLI stayed pending until the test backend released headers.
root_cause: packages/cli/src/services/http.service.ts httpLayer.request uses acquireRelease with its default uninterruptible acquisition, masking interruption of the fetch Promise.
fixed_by: Opt into interruptible acquisition for the scoped native fetch. Cancellation reaches its AbortSignal before response headers arrive while existing response/body finalizers and byte bounds remain intact.

invariants: Caller abort and CLI SIGINT promptly interrupt fetch while response headers are pending.
Accepted bodies remain bounded and cleaned up; backend failures keep the existing public diagnostic.

environment.revision: HEAD e081bde6054c8395209cdec145d8217c5d9c0dfd with uncommitted changes; baseline.json and after-baseline.json retain per-file SHA-256.
environment.target: Local macOS; Bun 1.3.10 and installed Effect 4.0.1; temporary loopback HTTP server and temporary project fixtures.
environment.monitoring: Existing operation observation and error/cleanup presentation exercised by native test harnesses. No external monitoring service was required or accessed.

reproduction: Start a real loopback server that accepts requests and withholds headers.
Abort a public jobs request after the backend receives it; require completion before releasing headers.
Spawn the actual jobs CLI, wait for its request, deliver SIGINT, and require exit 130 before releasing headers.
Replay successful JSON decoding and an HTTP 503 failure through the same live jobs facade.

before.note: Interrupting request acquisition aborts the native fetch signal before headers arrive.
Public caller cancellation and SIGINT exit complete before the backend releases headers.

after.note: Interrupting request acquisition aborts the native fetch signal before headers arrive.
Public caller cancellation and SIGINT exit complete before the backend releases headers.
The actual jobs capabilities CLI exits 130 on SIGINT while the backend still withholds headers.
Final code revision, pinned Effect version, and source/test hashes.
